members.name: Wentao Xiang
members.title: Leader
members.bio: Research focus: Physiological signal analysis, virtual reality rehabilitation technology, emotion recognition
members.introduction: Wentao Xiang (Member, IEEE) ,associate professor of Nanjing Medical University, was selected into the Outstanding Young Teacher Training Program of Nanjing Medical University. He has published more than 20 SCI papers in journals such as Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine, Computers in biology and medicine, etc. It has won more than 10 national invention patents, software copyrights, etc. He presided over the sub-tasks of the National Natural Science Youth Foundation project and the National Key R&D Program, and guided the students to win 7 awards in science and technology competitions at or above the provincial level.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：生理信号分析、虚拟现实康复技术、情感识别
zh-CN.introduction: Wentao Xiang（IEEE 会员）是南京医科大学副教授，入选南京医科大学优秀青年教师培养计划。在 Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine、Computers in Biology and Medicine 等期刊发表 SCI 论文 20 余篇，获国家发明专利 10 余项及软件著作权等成果。主持国家自然科学基金青年项目、国家重点研发计划子课题等，指导学生获得省级及以上科技竞赛奖励 7 项。

members.name: Hongbin Chen
members.title: Ph.D. Students
members.introduction: Hongbin Chen, a Student Member of the China Society of Image and Graphics and the Chinese Association for Artificial Intelligence. He is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in Biotechnology and Engineering at the School of Biomedical Engineering and Informatics, Nanjing Medical University. He is with the Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center for Smart Wearable and Rehabilitation Devices. His current research interests include multimodal emotion computing, computer vision in medicine and biomedical signal processing.

zh-CN.introduction: Hongbin Chen 是中国图象图形学学会和中国人工智能学会学生会员，目前在南京医科大学生物医学工程与信息学院攻读生物技术与工程硕士学位，并参与江苏省智能穿戴与康复器械工程研究中心的研究工作。研究兴趣包括多模态情感计算、医学计算机视觉与生物医学信号处理。

members.name: Shuai Shi
members.title: Master
members.introduction: Shuai Shi  is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in Biotechnology and Engineering at the School of Biomedical Engineering and Informatics, Nanjing Medical University. He is with the Jiangsu Province Engineering Research Center for Smart Wearable and Rehabilitation Devices. His current research interests include audio-visual emotion recognition, facial landmark detection, and facial robotics.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：机器人、情感识别
zh-CN.introduction: Shuai Shi 目前在南京医科大学生物医学工程与信息学院攻读生物技术与工程硕士学位，并参与江苏省智能穿戴与康复器械工程研究中心的研究工作。研究兴趣包括视听情感识别、面部关键点检测与面部机器人。

members.name: Keke Shi
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Elderly Emotion recognition,Emotional regulation
members.introduction: Keke Shi received the B.S. degree from Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China, in 2023. He is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in Biomedical Engineering at Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China. He is affiliated with the Jiangsu Province Smart Wearable and Rehabilitation Device Engineering Research Center, Nanjing, China.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：老年人情感识别、情绪调节
zh-CN.introduction: Keke Shi 于 2023 年获得郑州大学学士学位，目前在南京医科大学攻读生物医学工程硕士学位，并参与江苏省智能穿戴与康复器械工程研究中心的研究工作。

members.name: Zichen Song
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Virtual reality, multimodal physiological signal analysis, cognitive assessment in older adults
members.introduction: Zichen Song is dedicated to the assessment of cognitive function in older adults through the integration of virtual reality and multimodal physiological signal analysis. His work focuses on developing ecologically valid cognitive tasks using virtual reality technology, while combining electroencephalography, electrocardiography, and other physiological signals to evaluate cognitive functional states in aging populations. Through this interdisciplinary approach, he aims to provide more objective, immersive, and accurate methods for early cognitive assessment and health monitoring.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：虚拟现实、多模态生理信号分析、老年人认知评估
zh-CN.introduction: Zichen Song 致力于结合虚拟现实与多模态生理信号分析开展认知功能评估研究。通过虚拟现实技术构建具有生态效度的认知任务，结合脑电、心电及其他生理信号，评估老年群体的认知功能状态，希望为早期认知评估与健康监测提供更客观、沉浸式且准确的方法。

members.name: Nan Zhang
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Multimodal emotion recognition and large-model-based affective computing
members.introduction: Nan Zhang is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in Biotechnology and Engineering at the School of Biomedical Engineering and Informatics, Nanjing Medical University. Her current research interests include multimodal emotion recognition and large-model-based affective computing, and she mainly investigates emotional signal compensation and fusion strategies coping with missing modalities among mild cognitive impairment patients, as well as emotion recognition and reasoning with large models.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：多模态情感识别、基于大模型的情感计算
zh-CN.introduction: Nan Zhang 目前在南京医科大学生物医学工程与信息学院攻读生物技术与工程硕士学位。研究兴趣包括多模态情感识别和基于大模型的情感计算，主要研究轻度认知障碍患者在模态缺失情况下的情感信号补偿与融合策略，以及基于大模型的情感识别与推理。

members.name: Jinhui Wu
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Multimodal physiological signal analysis and cognitive load assessment in virtual reality
members.introduction: Jinhui Wu received the B.S. degree in Software Engineering from Zhejiang Wanli University, Ningbo, China, in 2023. He is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in Biomedical Engineering at Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China. His research interests include multimodal physiological signal analysis and cognitive load assessment in virtual reality.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：多模态生理信号分析、虚拟现实中的认知负荷评估
zh-CN.introduction: Jinhui Wu 于 2023 年获得浙江万里学院软件工程学士学位，目前在南京医科大学攻读生物医学工程硕士学位。研究兴趣包括多模态生理信号分析与虚拟现实中的认知负荷评估。

members.name: Junjie Wang
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Virtual reality, EEG signal analysis, working memory, cognitive assessment.
members.introduction: Junjie Wang’s research integrates virtual reality (VR) and electroencephalography (EEG) to assess cognitive function. Combining EEG and behavioral data, he compares brain activity, brain network connectivity, and task performance in healthy participants across VR and two-dimensional (2D) display environments. His work examines how presentation modalities influence working memory processing and explores the potential of these neural and behavioral measures for cognitive impairment screening.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：虚拟现实、脑电信号分析、工作记忆、认知评估
zh-CN.introduction: Junjie Wang 的研究结合虚拟现实（VR）与脑电（EEG）开展认知功能评估。他融合脑电与行为数据，比较健康受试者在虚拟现实与二维显示环境中的脑活动、脑网络连接和任务表现，探讨呈现方式对工作记忆加工的影响，并探索这些神经与行为指标在认知障碍筛查中的应用潜力。

members.name: Menglan Ruan
members.title: Master
members.bio: Research focus: Virtual reality, biomedical signal processing, and analysis
members.introduction: Menglan Ruan received the B.S. degree in computer science and technology from Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Chongqing, China, in 2023. She is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in software engineering with the School of Software Engineering, Southeast University, Nanjing, China.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：虚拟现实、生物医学信号处理与分析
zh-CN.introduction: Menglan Ruan 于 2023 年获得重庆邮电大学计算机科学与技术学士学位，目前在东南大学软件学院攻读软件工程硕士学位。

members.name: Louis Badaire
members.title: Exchange
members.bio: Research focus: Emotion recognition, Biomedical signal processing
members.introduction: Louis Badaire received his B.S. degree from the University of Rennes 1, France in 2024, and is non pursuing his M.S. degree in University of Rennes 1 under the supervising of Régine le Bouquin Jeannès. He is currently an exchange student at Nanjing Medical University, China. His research interests include emotion recognition and biomedical signal processing.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：情感识别、生物医学信号处理
zh-CN.introduction: Louis Badaire 于 2024 年获得法国雷恩第一大学学士学位，目前在该校攻读硕士学位，导师为 Régine le Bouquin Jeannès，现为南京医科大学交换生。研究兴趣包括情感识别与生物医学信号处理。

members.name: Jie Li
members.title: Collaborator
members.bio: Research focus: Motion capture, indoor localization, inertial navigation and positioning, gait analysis
members.introduction: Jie Li (Member, IEEE) received the M.S. degree in East China Jiaotong University, Jiangxi, China, in 2016, and the Ph.D. degree in control theory and control engineering from the School of Control Science and Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, in 2021. He was a postdoctoral researcher from 2021 to 2024 in the College of IoT Engineering, Hohai University, Jiangsu, China. Currently, he is an associate professor at the School of Biomedical Engineering and Informatics, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing, China.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：运动捕捉、室内定位、惯性导航与定位、步态分析
zh-CN.introduction: Jie Li（IEEE 会员）于 2016 年获得华东交通大学硕士学位，2021 年获得大连理工大学控制科学与工程学院控制理论与控制工程博士学位。2021 至 2024 年在河海大学物联网工程学院从事博士后研究，目前为南京医科大学生物医学工程与信息学院副教授。

members.name: Chunfeng Yang
members.title: Collaborator
members.bio: Research focus: Artificial intelligence and signal & image processing, medical health, brain–computer interface, wearable devices
members.introduction: Chunfeng Yang (Member, IEEE) received the Ph.D. degree from the University of Rennes 1, Rennes, France. He is currently with the Jiangsu Provincial Joint International Research Laboratory of Medical Information Processing, Key Laboratory of New Generation Artificial Intelligence Technology and Its Interdisciplinary Applications of the Ministry of Education, Southeast University, Nanjing, China, where he is also with the Laboratory of Image Science and Technology, School of Computer Science and Engineering, Southeast University.

zh-CN.bio: 研究方向：人工智能、信号与图像处理、医疗健康、脑机接口、可穿戴设备
zh-CN.introduction: Chunfeng Yang（IEEE 会员）获得法国雷恩第一大学博士学位，目前在东南大学从事研究工作，隶属于江苏省医学信息处理联合国际研究实验室、新一代人工智能技术及其交叉应用教育部重点实验室，并参与计算机科学与工程学院图像科学与技术实验室的研究。
